details: The United States conducted fresh strikes on 10 Iranian military sites, including surveillance and drone infrastructure, in the vicinity of the Strait of Hormuz. This action follows a series of tit-for-tat attacks, with the US citing Iranian drone strikes on commercial vessels and Iran claiming retaliatory strikes on US positions, both sides accusing each other of violating a ceasefire. This escalation introduces a significant macro risk to global financial markets.
title: US Strikes Iranian Military Targets Near Strait of Hormuz

details: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy announced that Ukraine's drone fleet successfully targeted two Russian oil refineries overnight in the Krasnodar and Yaroslavl regions. This is part of Kyiv's ongoing strategy to increase pressure on Russia's fuel supply, with previous attacks leading to acute fuel shortages in parts of Russia.
title: Ukraine Hits Russian Oil Refineries in Krasnodar and Yaroslavl
